patches.purpose: Skip the internal reference-package integrity precheck while retaining normal build finalization.
Patch builds: take the engine's own no-delta branch (jmp 0x444fca) instead of generating origin/target deltainfo, so the reference base package is never block-scanned.
patches.effect: Output PKG omits sce_sys/origin-deltainfo.dat, matching retail-style update packages; referable rate reported as N/A.
patches.measured: Horizon CUSA10213 update over a 46.5 GB base: 3m38s -> 3.6s, identical 400097280-byte PKG, img_verify --integrity_check on PASS with the unpatched engine.

standalone_img_verify: unchanged; tested against deliberately corrupted input
